name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Grab the key' is an unconditional command, so the hard Existence(has_key) is correct and, since at_goal carries only a soft Existence, has_key is lone and needs it. 'after that get to the goal square' gives the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) with the propositions in the right order (has_key first), which records the stated order even though the environment already enforces it via the door; it does not require dropping the key before the goal. 'if you can' is a preference cue scoping only 'get to the goal square', so the soft Existence(at_goal) is correctly soft and the 'after that' order correctly stays hard. The machine matches: has_key leads to the final state u1, at_goal without has_key falls into the rejecting state u2, and at_goal with has_key reaches u1 with the higher reward.

texts: The agent must grab the key at least once.
The agent may reach the goal only after grabbing the key.
If possible, the agent should reach the goal square.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 12
